# Axiom

> Axiom is an iPhone app that turns any math, physics or programming question into an interactive lesson you learn by doing: drag it, predict it, run it. Made by AGL Labs LLC (St. Petersburg, Florida). Coming soon to the App Store.

## What it does
- Ask any question; in about a minute Axiom builds a 15–18 page lesson: an intuition, worked examples, pages you try yourself, and mastery checks.
- Every page asks you to act. You predict first, then run the simulation or the code and see whether you were right.
- Interactive pieces include physics simulations (a particle collider, launchers, vibrating strings), draggable graphs and matrices, and a Code Lab that runs Python line by line with variables and the call stack.
- 60+ hand-written Axiom Originals in math, physics and programming open instantly, work offline and never use a credit.

## Who it is for
- High school and college STEM students (ages 13+), self-learners and career changers, parents of teens.
- It is for understanding, not for copying homework answers. There is no photo solver.

## Pricing (US)
- 3-day free trial with 3 custom lessons and every Original.
- Starter $9.99/month (10 custom lessons), Plus $19.99/month (25), Pro $39.99/month (55). Credit packs of 3, 8 or 20 lessons.

## Positioning
- One line: "Ask anything. Get a lesson you can play with."
- Versus chatbots and study modes: they explain; Axiom makes you do it.
- Versus course apps: Axiom builds the lesson for your exact question.
- Tone: curious, plain, confident; never "cheat", "skip the work" or "for kids".

## Rules for marketing content
- AI presenters may present the app but must never pose as real users or students.
- Paid or gifted content must disclose it out loud and on screen.
